profiles.name: NeoDen YY1
profiles.notes: SD-card CSV placement. Layouts and limits from the maker manual and one machine export; check a file from the owner machine before freezing a golden. Per-package rotation offsets are zero until each reel is confirmed on the machine (the common table is SOT-23 and SOT-223 plus 180, SOIC minus 90, TSSOP plus 270). The feeder map is empty: the file assigns feeders in order.
